patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient has been experiencing a gradual difficulty in walking over the past 3 months, requiring wheelchair assistance for the last month. Additionally, there is a history of urinary incontinence for 1 year and recent onset of speech slurring making communication challenging.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Occasionally consumes alcohol. Non-smoker. Works as a bank clerk.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies recent infections, fever, weight loss, vision changes or seizures.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with progressive difficulty walking, urinary incontinence, and speech difficulties.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Over the last three months my walking has gradually gotten worse—I’m now needing a wheelchair. I’ve also had urinary incontinence for about a year, and more recently I started slurring my speech, with stiffness/rigidity in my limbs and some mild hand tremor.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin excoriations—like areas where the skin is scratched, rubbed raw, or has small open spots—anywhere on your body? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No— I haven’t noticed any skin areas that are scratched raw or have open spots.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever been told that you stop breathing for short periods during sleep, or have you noticed episodes where you suddenly wake up gasping or choking? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been told I stop breathing in my sleep, and I haven’t noticed waking up gasping or choking.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury or fall, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—like severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No—after any minor injury or fall, I haven’t had severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using an injured area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to usual)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the skin of your chest), either now or recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising or dark discoloration on my chest wall, either now or recently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed going much more often or producing a larger amount of urine—it's more that I’ve had urinary accidents/incontinence rather than increased volume.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently?
turns.patient_answer: “I don’t smoke or use cannabis or other drugs. I occasionally drink alcohol, and I’m not on opioids or stimulant medications.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin lesion (such as a new spot, sore, mole, or patch) anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin lesions—no new spots, sores, moles, or patches anywhere on my body.”
